patch.value: Implement native context history and dependency orientation with oracle parity
Brief context, verified history reads, dependency listing, large public tracker latency and exact gates against the pinned oracle.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Plan: implement native brief context focus selection and packing, append-only history reads, and dependency tree reads. Compare complete CLI bytes against the locked oracle on disposable trackers. Document unsupported flags explicitly, retain release disablement, and record revert controls, large public tracker latency and all local/platform gates. Pinned history reads do not verify by default; --verify returns a verification report rather than refusing on a broken record hash. Preserve this observable oracle behavior and document the distinction.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation in progress: native brief relevance ordering and identity packing, compact/full history with strict integrity exit, and bounded dependency tree/graph reads. Initial local build succeeds. Added real-CLI fixed-clock differential fixtures; extending refusal and corruption cases before the aggregate gate. CLI orientation requires a complete initialized settings document; fixtures now use real pm init rather than a partial settings surrogate.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: First real-CLI differential: history passed, including immutable-author tampering with --verify --strict-exit. Dependency truncation exposed an internal row-contract token estimate, now matched. Context exposed an oracle behavior: the 25 ms packing deadline can expire before the first selection when this shared host deschedules Node, returning zero focus rows and suggestions despite active candidates. The orientation fixture now pins the monotonic clock as well as Date to test deterministic bytes. Native packing completes deterministically; document this timing boundary and report it as an oracle UX gap rather than claiming scheduling equivalence.

value.note: Exact orientation CLI bytes and read-only concurrent storage acceptance

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The six-test orientation differential passed: context focus/budgets/cursors, history integrity and retained rewrite evidence, dependency traversal/refusals, explicit unsupported options, read-only storage during concurrent unrelated writes, and group caps/session affinity. Added further weekly-calendar and bounded-history cases. Benchmark preflight found one closed weekly UTC event in the unchanged public-tracker copy; expanding that existing calendar shape instead of filtering the dataset. Local isolated strict health passed eight checks with four advisories; ambient health separately reports the global extension host-version skew. Timings and full coverage are still pending.

value.note: Exact orientation CLI bytes and read-only concurrent storage acceptance

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The extended native orientation differential suite passed 8 tests, including bounded large history, immutable record tampering, retained rewrite evidence, weekly recurrence, semantic and delivered usage affinity, and concurrent unrelated writes. The context reader now captures one authoritative corpus for ranking and summaries; its real-filesystem scan-count regression passed. Clippy all-targets deny-warnings passed. Draft PR #92 is open. Coverage, revert controls and the final shared-host timing receipt remain pending.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: All three operating-system test jobs passed on the initial PR head. The Linux aggregate gate then correctly refused coverage below 100 percent: lines 99.3069, functions 99.3892, regions 99.2402, branches 96.5957. Boundary acceptance exposed and corrected a timestamp-unit mismatch in feedback retention, touch windows and deadline scoring; 26 orientation unit tests now pass. Additional budget, dispatch and integrity tests are being added without reducing gate thresholds.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proofs: cargo test --locked --lib record_envelopes_and_replay_hashes failed 0 passed/1 failed when only record_error was replaced by its pre-slice no-verification behavior (None versus record_hash_mismatch). cargo test --locked --lib session_and_usage_affinity failed 0/1 when only affinity returned empty evidence (0 versus 3 claims). cargo test --locked --lib dependency_value_refusals failed 0/1 when only index discarded the new relationship rows (2 versus 3 nodes). Each control rebuilt successfully, failed an assertion, then restored its source bytes and verified SHA-256 equality. No counterfactual source is committed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The mandatory pm test --run --progress completed successfully: 1 linked command, 9 differential tests passed, 0 failed. The positive library pass completed 218 tests and the orientation dispatch pass completed 2 tests. The subsequent array-test replay fix passed its targeted unit regression; its sealed real-oracle fixture and pre-command global refusal tests are included for the next full run. Private rustdoc and all-target Clippy passed before those two final dispatch/replay refinements; the current checks are running.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Current boundary work: 227 library tests passed after correcting a synthetic budget envelope to carry the summary a real context producer supplies. The prior candidate CI failures are retained as failed evidence. Real storage failures, incomplete RFC 6902 operands, multiple retained proof generations, legacy optional rows and a split-surrogate TOON refusal now have acceptance fixtures. Minimal static extension discovery has a real CLI differential fixture; richer manifest/policy diagnostics refuse explicitly and declared context_relevance overrides refuse even with health omitted. Benchmark runtimes use the same isolated global-user environment with the complete copied public tracker. Final aggregate gates and latency samples are pending.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Candidate e36b9bb CI and the first isolated local aggregate stopped at the unchanged Clippy 100-line function limit after expanding one test to 114 lines. The test is now split into API and cache/extension cases; all-target deny-warnings Clippy passed, and the restarted isolated aggregate passed fmt, Clippy and private rustdoc before entering all-target tests. Minimal-extension byte parity passed 1 real differential test; declared service refusal passed its targeted unit test. The 30-run benchmark has begun with a separate verified copy of the same locked 2026.10.14 oracle, isolated global user state, and a fixed release-binary fingerprint.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Additional behavioral proof: cargo test --locked --test orientation_differential history_reserved_patch_paths_match_oracle failed 0 passed/1 failed against the preceding verifier. A sealed two-record fixture made the oracle report verify_failed:patch_apply_failed:entry_2 while native reported a different replay-hash error for constructor/prototype. Adding the pinned codec prototype guard to destinations and copy/move sources made the identical test pass 1/0. Numeric exponent/hex control parity also passed 1/0. After cleaning only package build artifacts, the current library pass is 230/0 and all-target deny-warnings Clippy passed. The partial old-binary timing series and interrupted aggregate are not final evidence; both are being restarted for the corrected build.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The full 2991-item public tracker copy passed an additional exact context comparison with fixed wall/packing clocks and an isolated synthetic author: JSON stdout 11839 bytes and default TOON stdout 7219 bytes were identical, stderr empty, exits 0. Candidate b573b8b passed all three OS test jobs; its aggregate coverage exposed one unreachable context budget branch after the shared writer had already returned the same budget error. That redundant branch is removed. The corrected prototype verifier passed its sealed-record differential proof, 230 library tests passed, and current all-target Clippy passed. The release timing series and complete isolated aggregate will now run against this frozen production implementation.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The extension directory guard has a behavioral revert proof: removing only the new file-type guard makes context_cache_and_extension_boundaries fail on a symlink to a manifest declaring a context relevance override (exit 101); restoring the exact source bytes passes (1 test). A new real-process test covers strict verification success and a closed history output pipe, including unchanged history bytes. All three OS Rust test jobs pass at fa30341; aggregate coverage remains incomplete, so final gates and timing are being rerun against frozen source.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The final 30-run cold-process receipt is complete on the full 2991-item public tracker copy. Native/oracle p50 milliseconds: context 1067.7/1175.2, list 731.6/445.3, search history 787.4/1345.1, get 692.6/433.7. Native list/get are slower; record all results and track optimization separately. Effective nice 19; 4 CPUs, shared host; 1-minute load ranged 9.04 to 17.59. SHA-256 verification found zero changed files among all 6004 authoritative source files and their copied equivalents. Release binary source 22f7fd0; subsequent changes are acceptance fixtures only. Additional fixtures cover inherited tags, populated extension health, isolated usage-disable behavior and both retained-proof hash algorithms.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Windows Rust CI at 22f7fd0 exposed a real existing publisher defect: orientation concurrency failed 11 passed/1 failed because an unrelated item vanished between delete and rename. The replacement publisher now uses the standard replacement rename without a prior unlink, preserving existing locks and recovery journals. A deterministic real-filesystem test requires failed publication to preserve destination bytes. Reinstating the previous Windows delete-before-rename behavior portably on Linux made that test fail 0 passed/1 failed (exit 101); restoring exact source bytes passed 1/0. This is a behavioral control of the Windows sequence, not a Windows-local execution claim. The pre-fix pm-linked differential run passed 12/0; repeat on the final source. The previous incomplete aggregate is superseded. No coverage thresholds or exclusions changed.
